ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white central region and 35% low-intensity black periphery and peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across central lobes; dark-intensity pixels form a solid band along the trailing edge and outer margins. Dark radial striations extend from the median notch into the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a central pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge, with higher frequency jaggedness on the distal lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes extending from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular nodes (barnacles) localized on both distal fluke tips and the posterior peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned dark-gray linear marks (rake scars) breaking the white pigmentation on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Sessile barnacle colonization on the distal extremities and trailing edges; significant dark-pigmented rake mark scarring on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical dark banding and fine speckling concentrated specifically around the median notch region.
